P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.offline_read_of_already_replicated_recor: DENY for any scope whose permission epoch cannot be confirmed within the confirmation window, with reason offline_confirmation_required
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.within_confirmation_window: ALLOW only for scopes with no pending permission event in the replica's inbound queue; response must carry permission_epoch, epoch_as_of, freshness=unconfirmed_offline, staleness_seconds
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.staleness_measured_from: issuing authority's stamp on the last applied permission epoch; replica local wall clock is not authoritative
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.offline_action_qualification: DENY with reason offline_no_authorization_confirmation; never qualified, never deferred-then-auto-approved
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.cached_result_serving_when_revocation_kn: REFUSE and invalidate, per requesting principal
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.source_state_when_source_access_revoked: current state UNKNOWN; last-known fact retained with original observation time and marked stale
P-OFFLINE-DENY-V2.revocation_semantics: revocation restricts serving only; stored bytes are retained unchanged
